build_bilinear_grid_sample: build a python module to bilinearly sample feature map pixels using a flow-field grid with custom interpolation
create_regular_grid: create a regular square grid of normalized point coordinates in [0,1]x[0,1] space for sampling
convert_roi_points: convert ROI-relative point coordinates to image-absolute coordinates using bounding box regions of interest
sample_points_from_features: sample feature values at normalized point coordinates from an input feature map using grid_sample
build_roi_align: build a SimpleRoIAlign module to align and sample features from regions of interest with configurable output size
